comment: The pilot universe: the 18 companies of SFI_ARCHITECTURE_V2.md Appendix A, with
name, NGX ticker, sector and the statement template each is entered under.
Names and tickers here are what the Nigerian Exchange says today, not what the
CEO's coverage document said when it was written. Where the two differ,
priorName, priorTicker and source record the change and its evidence, and
scripts/verify-ngx-directory.mjs reports it for sign-off. A wrong ticker is a
wrong company, and this file is the identity the whole five-year history hangs
No figures here, and none seeded. A company with nothing verified reads

excluded.name: Flour Mills of Nigeria Plc
excluded.reason: Delisted from the NGX Daily Official List with effect from 30 December 2024, following the Excelsior Shipping scheme of arrangement approved at the court-ordered meeting of 14 November 2024; trading was suspended on 16 December 2024. The CEO's document excluded it pending confirmation of its listing status, and this is that confirmation. Keep as an archived profile only.

companies.name: Access Holdings Plc
companies.note: Holding company established 2022. Earlier years belong to Access Bank Plc and are linked by a succession record, never merged.

companies.name: First HoldCo Plc
companies.source: NGX market bulletin NGXREG/IRD/MB15/25/03/5, 5 March 2025: change of name implemented, "FBNH to FirstHoldCo". Approved at the AGM of 14 November 2024.
companies.note: The exchange writes the symbol FirstHoldCo; data vendors render it FIRSTHOLDCO. Stored uppercase, as every other ticker here is.

companies.name: MTN Nigeria Communications Plc
companies.note: Account for FX movements when comparing profits across years.

companies.name: Airtel Africa Plc
companies.note: Reports in US dollars. Figures are stored in USD as reported; any naira equivalent is a derived conversion with its own rate and source.

companies.name: HBM Nigeria Plc
companies.source: NGX market bulletin NGXREG/IRD/MB76/26/07/09, 9 July 2026: change of name implemented, "WAPCO to HBMNG". Approved at the AGM of 30 April 2026, following a new certificate of incorporation from the Corporate Affairs Commission.
companies.note: HBM is Huaxin Building Materials, after Holcim sold its majority stake to Huaxin Cement. The pre-2026 annual reports are filed under Lafarge Africa Plc, so the documents desk will carry both names.

companies.name: BUA Foods Plc
companies.note: Listed 2022. Earlier history comes from pre-listing audited statements and is linked by a succession record.

companies.name: Aradel Holdings Plc
companies.note: Listed 2024. Earlier figures come from historical audited statements and are linked by a succession record.
